title: Longest Uncommon Subsequence Length
description: A string is an uncommon subsequence of two strings if it is a subsequence of one but not the other. Given strings `a` and `b`, return the length of the longest uncommon subsequence, or -1 if no such subsequence exists. Input: `a` and `b`. Output: the length or -1.
constraints: a and b contain lowercase English letters
hints: Track only the character counts or prefixes needed to decide the next step.
Check repeated symbols, empty or minimal cases, and impossible arrangements.
